Dear Dr. Lisanti:

With reference to the matters raised in Dr. Fishman's letter of June 24th, the Comptroller has verified for me the following statements.

We can fund 60% of Dr. Freeman's salary in addition to the 40% portion on his Council for Tobacco Research application if his grant is funded on August 1st.

There are funds in Dr. Fishman's current grant to support Dr. Yoshida, Dr. Kottel and G. Stenstrom till July 30, 1978, but not beyond this date.

For the uninterrupted fiscal support of Fishman and Freeman's projects, this office supports an August 1st activation date.

Yours sincerely,

[SIGNATURE] Sidney Green

Sidney Green

Vice President for

Operations and Development
